measurement_scope: Planning baseline: serialized bytes, not packet capture, memory profiling or throughput testing
encoding: UTF-8 JSON, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false; MCP text block retains server json.dumps formatting

local_workflow_measurement.question: Can I change payment-gateway timeout from 400ms to 4ms?
local_workflow_measurement.trace_shape: workflow trace plus response_details, turn, review_mode and question; no Admin summary duplication

exclusions: No new Groq or Slack request was made for these measurements
Byte measurements exclude JSON-RPC request/initialization framing and transport overhead
One trace is not a p95 or worst-case size bound
Storage estimates exclude indexes, replication, compression and extra error/security detail
Tool body sizes do not measure executable code or model weights
No raw memory record, owner security record or credential is included
